rows.name: Greenock
rows.character: 1. Two fixed red lts. 2. Two fixed lights 3. One fix. red or br. lt. 4. One occult. bright light, 8 secs.
rows.description: 1. About half a mile N.W. of Albert Quay. In line S.W. ½ S. lead towards anchorage 2. Green light on Prince's pier; bright light in front of custom-house 3. At Garvel dock; bright ray to East up river 4. Lt.-vessel in 12 ft. water off Garvel Point. Light visible 4 secs., and eclipsed twice in next 4 secs.

rows.name: Port Glasgow
rows.description: One fixed bright lt. off entrance, and another on steam-boat quay. Red lights at entrances

rows.name: Cardross
rows.description: Fixed red light on Pillar Bank

rows.name: Bowling Bay
rows.description: Fixed bright light, East entrance of harbour

rows.name: Garmoyle Lightvessel
rows.description: Fixed bright light 3 miles above Port Glasgow

rows.name: Dumbarton
rows.description: Red light on pier in winter, for steamers

rows.name: Dumbuck
rows.description: Fixed bright light, South side of channel

rows.name: Donald's Quay
rows.description: Red and bright light on outer end

rows.name: Rashielee Park
rows.description: Fixed bright light to indicate bend of channel

rows.name: Dalmuir
rows.description: Fixed red light on North bank, bend of channel

rows.name: Ardrossan
rows.description: White lighthouse, 23 ft. high, on breakwater. Light bright 2 secs., eclipsed 2 secs. Shown between West and W.S.W.

rows.name: Irvine Harbour
rows.description: Leading lights, inner red, outer green

rows.name: Troon Harbour
rows.character: Int. br. lt., & fix. red lt.
rows.description: White lt.-ho. on inner end of pier. Lt. vis. 40 secs., eclipsed 20 secs. Red lt. on pier-head. In one, S.W. ½ S., 350 yards apart

rows.name: Ayr Harbour
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright lt. 2. One fixed red light 3. One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: 1. Tower on North side of harbour 2. On inner end of N. pier, while 8 ft. on bar 3. On South pier-head, red South of W. ¼ N., and bright to North

rows.name: Turnberry Point
rows.description: White brick tower, 64 ft. high, at ruined castle

rows.name: Girvan Harbour
rows.description: A fixed red light on pier end

rows.name: AILSA CRAIG
rows.character: One flash. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: Lighthouse, 35 ft. high, on extr. of gravel spit on E. side. Lt. shows quick flashes for 15 secs., followed by 15 secs. eclipse. Visible betw. N. by W. and S.W. by W., through E.

rows.name: Loch Ryan
rows.description: White tower, 50 ft. high, on Cairn Ryan Point

rows.name: Stranraer
rows.description: Br. lt. on E. pier. Red lt. on W. pier. Green lt. at inner end when Irish steamer expected

rows.name: CORSEWALL
rows.character: One rev. br. & red lt. 1 m.
rows.description: White tower, 110 feet high, on West side of entrance to Loch Ryan

rows.name: Port Patrick
rows.description: Brick tower, 32 ft. high, at S.E. angle of the harbour

rows.name: MULL OF GALLOWAY
rows.description: Stone lighthouse, 86 feet high, on S.E. point. Light visible ½ min., eclipsed ¼ min. Shown between N.N.E. and N.W. ½ W.

rows.name: LITTLE ROSS ISLAND
rows.description: White tower, 65 feet high. Light not visible inshore between N.W. by W. and N. by E.

rows.name: Kirkcudbright
rows.description: Red light on East pier; bright and green tide light on Tans Lake perch

rows.name: Annan River
rows.description: On Barnkirk or Annan Foot, from half-flood to half-ebb

rows.name: FASTNET ROCK
rows.description: Circular white tower, 92 feet high, with red belt, on the summit of the rock

rows.name: Baltimore Harbour
rows.description: A fixed bright light on West entrance point

rows.name: GALLEY HEAD
rows.description: White lighthouse, 69 ft. high, on summit of head. Light shows 6 or 7 flashes during 16 secs., and is obscured 44 secs. Visible between West and E. by S.

rows.name: KINSALE OLD HEAD
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 100 ft. high, with two red belts, on South point. A red ray over outer part of Courtmacsherry Bay, from the Seven Heads to Horse Rocks

rows.name: Kinsale Harbour
rows.description: From window in Fort Charles, on East side of the harbour

rows.name: DAUNT'S ROCK LT.-V.
rows.description: Vessel black, three masts, in 16 fms., at 13 cables S.E. ½ S. from Daunt's Rock, and 4½ miles S.S.W. from entr. to Cork Harbour
